description: This file is a Markdown documentation file describing the ElectronApplication class and related events and methods in the Playwright library. It does not contain executable source code but provides detailed documentation and usage examples for controlling Electron applications via Playwright.

classes.name: ElectronApplication
classes.description: Represents a launched Electron application instance, providing methods to interact with the app, its windows, and events.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a function in the context of the Electron application and returns its result.

methods.name: evaluateHandle
methods.description: Evaluates a function in the context of the Electron application and returns a JSHandle to its result.

methods.name: firstWindow
methods.description: Waits for and returns the first application window as a Page object.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Returns the main process (ChildProcess) for this Electron application.

methods.name: waitForEvent
methods.description: Waits for a specific event to fire in the Electron application and returns its data.

methods.name: windows
methods.description: Returns an array of all open windows (Page objects) for the Electron application.
